title: Editor experience
description: How editing feels to people: input delay, engine work, opens, sessions, edits, saves, and refusals.

list.name: Version started reporting
list.expr: count by (app_version) (docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}) unless count by (app_version) (docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"} offset 2m)
list.titleFormat: Version {{app_version}} reports and did not 2 minutes earlier: a release, or reporting resumed after a gap

panels.title: Input delay, 95th percentile
panels.description: Time from a key press or click on the pages to the next frame on screen, over the selected range. 95 in 100 presses were faster. Estimated from the timing bands. The highest finite band ends at 1 s, so a value of 1 s means the percentile is in the over 1 s band; see Presses by delay band.

panels.title: Input delay, median
panels.description: Time from a key press or click on the pages to the next frame on screen, over the selected range. Half the presses were faster. Estimated from the timing bands. The highest finite band ends at 1 s, so a value of 1 s means the percentile is in the over 1 s band; see Presses by delay band.

panels.title: Presses over 200 ms
panels.description: Share of timed presses that took more than 200 ms to reach the screen, over the selected range. People notice a delay of this length. Presses over 1 s are rare and usually happen while a document loads; see Presses by delay band.

panels.title: Opens succeeding
panels.description: Successful opens out of successful opens plus failures the app causes, over the selected range. Broken files are left out; see Refused files.

panels.title: Open time, median
panels.description: From the start of an open to the first laid-out page, for successful opens over the selected range. Half the opens were faster. Estimated from the timing bands. The median is shown because a few large files decide the 95th percentile; see Open time for both.

panels.title: Sources reporting, last 5 minutes
panels.description: Distinct metric sources (job and instance) that sent timings in the last 5 minutes. With a random service.instance.id per page, as in the examples, each source is one open page, and a reload is a new one. A collector that aggregates browsers reports fewer sources. Zero while people edit means telemetry stopped, not that editing is healthy.

panels.title: Unexpected refusals per 1,000 presses
panels.description: Refusals other than expected ones (read-only, protected, stale target), for every 1,000 timed presses, over the selected range.

panels.title: Dropped telemetry events
panels.description: Events the privacy check dropped. Not zero usually means core and telemetry versions differ. No data means no editor reported.

panels.title: Input delay
panels.description: Key press or click to the next frame on screen: the delay a person feels. Estimated from the timing bands. The highest finite band ends at 1 s, so a value of 1 s means the percentile is in the over 1 s band; see Presses by delay band. Too few presses. The value appears after 20 presses in the window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() sum by () (increase(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval])) >= 20

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() sum by () (increase(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval])) >= 20

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() sum by () (increase(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval])) >= 20

panels.title: Presses timed
panels.description: Key presses and clicks timed, per minute. Shows how much editing the other panels describe.

panels.title: Presses by delay band
panels.description: Share of presses in each delay band. Growth in the upper bands means editing got slower.

panels.title: Input delay by document size (95th percentile)
panels.description: Large documents lay out more per edit. If only the large buckets are slow, the delay follows document size. Too few presses. The value appears after 20 presses in the window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pages) (rate(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version",pages!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(pages) sum by (pages) (increase(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version",pages!=""}[$__rate_interval])) >= 20

panels.title: Input delay by app version (95th percentile)
panels.description: Your app releases, from the app.version attribute you send. A release slower than the one before points to it. Too few presses. The value appears after 20 presses in the window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, app_version) (rate(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version",app_version!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(app_version) sum by (app_version) (increase(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version",app_version!=""}[$__rate_interval])) >= 20

panels.title: Input delay by editor version (95th percentile)
panels.description: The docx-editor packages that measured it. Compare editor upgrades. Too few presses. The value appears after 20 presses in the window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, docx_editor_version) (rate(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version",docx_editor_version!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(docx_editor_version) sum by (docx_editor_version) (increase(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version",docx_editor_version!=""}[$__rate_interval])) >= 20

panels.title: Input delay, now and a week ago (95th percentile)
panels.description: The same time a week earlier. Empty until the stack has a week of data.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() sum by () (increase(docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval])) >= 20

panels.title: Layout passes by duration band
panels.description: Share of engine layout passes after edits and view changes in each duration band. Each pass is timed alone, so many short passes can still add up to a slow press.

panels.title: Paint passes by duration band
panels.description: Share of engine paint passes after edits and view changes in each duration band. Each pass is timed alone, so many short passes can still add up to a slow press.

panels.title: Layout time by document size (95th percentile)
panels.description: Engine layout passes by page count bucket. If one size is much slower than the others, layout of that size causes the input delay. A size needs 20 passes in the window to show a value.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pages) (rate(docx_editor_editor_layout_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version",pages!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(pages) sum by (pages) (increase(docx_editor_editor_layout_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version",pages!=""}[$__rate_interval])) >= 20

panels.title: Opens per minute
panels.description: Documents opened and refused, per minute.

panels.title: Open time
panels.description: From the start of an open to the first laid-out page, for opens that succeeded. Too few opens. The value appears after 5 opens in the window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(docx_editor_document_open_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() sum by () (increase(docx_editor_document_open_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval])) >= 5

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(docx_editor_document_open_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on() sum by () (increase(docx_editor_document_open_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__rate_interval])) >= 5

panels.title: Refused files by reason
panels.description: Why files did not open, most frequent first, with the engine reason and the role of the part that failed. Each code links to its hint.

defaults.noValue: No recorded events in this range

panels.title: Sessions started
panels.description: Editors created over the selected range. One editor is one session; a reload starts a new one.

panels.title: Active editing time
panels.description: Time people spent using editors over the selected range: key presses, clicks, and edits at most 30 s apart. Pauses do not count.

panels.title: Session length, median
panels.description: From the creation of an editor to its end, idle time included, for sessions that ended over the selected range. Estimated from the buckets.

panels.title: Edits failing
panels.description: Unexpected refusals out of all edit attempts (edits that changed the document plus refused edits), over the selected range. Expected refusals, such as edits in a read-only document, are left out of the top number.

panels.title: Saves succeeding
panels.description: Calls to save() that returned the document, out of all calls, over the selected range.

panels.title: Save time, 95th percentile
panels.description: From a save() call to the saved bytes, for successful saves over the selected range. Estimated from the buckets.

panels.title: People editing at once
panels.description: Seconds of use per second: about the number of people actively editing at the same time. Session summaries arrive up to a minute late.

panels.title: Sessions per hour
panels.description: Editors created (start) and destroyed or closed with their page (end), per hour.

panels.title: Edits per minute by source
panels.description: Edits that changed the document: typing and other input, editor commands, or editing API batches. Edits by collaborators are counted by their own editor.

panels.title: Save time, successful saves
panels.description: From a save() call to the saved bytes. Grows with document size.

panels.title: Failed saves by reason
panels.description: Why save() failed, most frequent first. Each code links to its hint.

defaults.noValue: No failed saves in this range

panels.title: Refused while suggesting
panels.description: Edits, commands, and agent batches refused while changes were tracked, over the selected range.

panels.title: Tracked changes skipped
panels.description: Tracked changes that accept, reject, or reassign requests skipped, over the selected range.

panels.title: Share of refusals while suggesting
panels.description: Refusals while changes were tracked, out of all refusals, over the selected range.

panels.title: Refused tracked changes by reason
panels.description: Why edits were refused while changes were tracked, most frequent first, with the engine reason. Each code links to its hint.

defaults.noValue: No recorded events in this range

panels.title: Refused tracked changes per minute by source
panels.description: Typing and pointer input, toolbar commands, or an editing API batch, while changes were tracked.

panels.title: Skipped tracked changes by reason
panels.description: Tracked changes that accept, reject, or reassign requests skipped, by reason, operation, and kind of change. Each code links to its hint.

targets.expr: topk(10, label_replace(sum by (code, cause, operation, change_kind) (increase(docx_editor_review_skipped_total{job=~"$job",deployment_environment=~"$env",app_version=~"$version",docx_editor_version=~"$editor_version"}[$__range])), "anchor", "$1-$2", "code", "([^.]+)\\.(.+)") > 0)

defaults.noValue: No recorded events in this range

panels.title: Refused edits by reason
panels.description: The public code of each refused edit, command, or tracked change, with the engine reason, most frequent first. Each code links to its hint.

defaults.noValue: No recorded events in this range

panels.title: Refused edits per minute by source
panels.description: Typing and pointer input, toolbar commands, or an editing API batch. Tracked means the person was suggesting.

panels.title: Font substitutions by reason
panels.description: Fonts that failed to load. The editor used a substitute.

defaults.noValue: No recorded events in this range

panels.title: Dropped telemetry by reason
panels.description: Events the privacy check dropped, by reason.

defaults.noValue: No recorded events in this range
